-- Agent created this file github actions, can use for future reference --

name: Cypress E2E

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [dev, master]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  push:
    branches: [dev, master]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: e2e-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  cypress:
    name: Cypress E2E
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24.13.0"
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: cypress-io/github-action@v6
        with:
          build: npm run build
          start: npm run start
          wait-on: "http://localhost:3000"
          browser: chrome
        env:
          NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
